descriptive_displays.spearman_method: classical distinct-rank formula on the frozen tie-broken ranks (1 = largest, ties by case_id ascending); bare descriptive number, no interval

reversal_accounting.label: Share of the NET band-2/3 gap after cancellation across the opposing cases. Reversal accounting only: neither this number nor its difference from the support share may be interpreted as contribution per unit support or as evidence of keystone-like dominance.

sole_disproportionality_comparison.rule: These are the only two numbers the proportionality clause may cite; exact arithmetic scoped to the realized cases; no threshold, interval, test, or is/is-not verdict.
